title: Sam's First Flight
sentences: Sam has a small red plane.
The plane needs fuel to fly.
Sam reads to fill the tank.
Now Sam can soar high!

title: The Cat Can Fly
sentences: The cat can fly.
The cat has a cape.
The cat is so brave.
We love the cat!

title: Sun and Moon
sentences: The sun is big.
The moon is small.
The sun can not fly.
The plane can fly high.

title: Big Blue Sky
sentences: I see the sky.
The sky is blue.
A bird is in the sky.
The plane is in the sky too.

title: The Little Pilot
sentences: Mia wants to be a pilot.
She checks the map for adventure.
The little plane needs more fuel.
Mia reads a story out loud.
Now the plane can cross the sea!

title: Cloud Island
sentences: There is an island in the clouds.
The island has a big tree.
A small bird lives in the tree.
The plane brings a letter to the bird.
The bird is so happy to read it!

title: Star Journey
sentences: The night sky is full of stars.
The plane flies past the moon.
Captain Leo counts the bright stars.
He writes the number in his log.
Tomorrow he will fly even farther.

title: The Rainy Rescue
sentences: It was a rainy day on the hill.
A lost puppy waited by the barn.
The pilot heard a soft bark.
She landed her plane in the soft grass.
The puppy jumped in and smiled.

title: The Jungle Airstrip
sentences: Deep in the jungle there is a hidden airstrip.
Explorer Ana needs to deliver medicine.
The runway is short and covered with leaves.
Ana reads the wind meter very carefully.
Her careful reading helps her land safely.
The village cheers when the plane stops.

title: The Desert Race
sentences: Two planes race across the desert at sunrise.
The red plane is fast but the blue plane is steady.
A sudden wind pushes both planes sideways.
The pilots remember to stay calm and focused.
They finish together and laugh about the adventure.
Reading the wind made them better pilots.

title: Arctic Delivery
sentences: Captain Noor flies over the frozen arctic sea.
She carries warm blankets for the research station.
Snow clouds make it hard to see ahead.
Noor reads her compass and stays on course.
The station lights appear through the falling snow.
Everyone is grateful for her brave flight.

title: City Lights
sentences: The city has many bright lights.
The plane flies over the tall towers.
Cars look like tiny ants below.
The pilot waves to the people down there.
At night the city looks like stars on earth.

title: Ocean Rescue
sentences: A sailboat is stuck in the middle of the ocean.
The wind has torn its big white sail.
Pilot Jon hears the call for help on his radio.
He drops a new rope down to the boat.
The sailors pull the rope and feel hope again.
Teamwork and quick reading saved the day.

title: Mountain Quest
sentences: High on the mountain lives an old inventor.
She built a glider that has no engine.
The glider needs a strong wind to take off.
The young pilot reads the mountain wind chart.
When the wind is right she jumps into the sky.
She soars like an eagle over the peaks.

title: Space Dream
sentences: Ben dreams of flying to space.
His paper plane can not go that high.
He reads books about rockets every night.
One day he will build his own rocket.
For now he flies his plane with joy.
